hook: Shankel built her career in the operational and technical backbone of the automotive industry, general management, manufacturing processes, market expansion, before moving into the CTO seat at a commercial vehicle manufacturer and then founding her own technology company. Her PhD in organizational leadership combined with hands-on OEM manufacturing experience places her at the intersection of people-driven transformation and industrial technology adoption.
name: Kelleigh Shankel

quote.text: Adaptive executive leader with a proven track record of process improvement, manufacturing growth, market expansion, and technological change.

reading.body:
Kelleigh Shankel's career traces a consistent line from operational general management in automotive supply chains to technology leadership, ending, so far, in founding her own company.

The timeline covers roughly fourteen years across four distinct roles before her current position. Each step moved closer to the technical side of the business: division management at a major automotive supplier, aftermarket and performance vehicle operations, then U.S. country management, then CTO of a specialty vehicle manufacturer. The PhD in organizational leadership, completed while she held the Managing Director role, adds a formal framework to what was already a practice-built understanding of how people and processes interact inside manufacturing organizations.

The data covers her background and stated expertise. It does not describe what Limelight Logic builds, what problems it is solving, or how her manufacturing experience connects to any specific technology product or market. The link to compute, power, or AI infrastructure is not present in this record, and nothing in it supports drawing one. What the record does establish is a founder whose formation was in industrial operations and vehicle manufacturing, not in software or data infrastructure, which is itself useful context for understanding where she is likely to bring the most distinctive judgment.
